record.body:
## Decision

Update AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md cross-refs from se-workflow to **affidavit** (CLI `aff`). Docs-only.

## Rationale

affidavit packaging Landing R6. Product and GitHub renamed; AA docs still named the old plugin. Approved via Landing (user: run it yourself).

## Counter-argument

Leaving old names would keep docs accurate for anyone still on a se-workflow checkout path, but the shipped product name is affidavit.
record.subject: rename-affidavit-cross-refs
